full_name: Michael Pollan | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2015–2016 Journalism & Nonfiction Suzanne Young Murray Fellow University of California, Berkeley
bio: Michael Pollan writes about human engagement with the natural world, in the landscape, on our plates, and in our imaginations, with a focus on the profound transformations that engagement can occasion.
